name: Interactive Brokers
summary: Primary concern is rich valuation, with mixed signals in other areas.

meanings.ret1y: Solid 1-year gain, ahead of the typical market return.
meanings.fromHigh: Modest pullback from recent highs, typical consolidation.
meanings.rsi14: Approaching oversold levels — selling pressure building.
meanings.aboveMAs: Above 1 of 3 averages — mixed trend signals.
meanings.macd: MACD negative and falling — bearish momentum.
meanings.vol: High volatility, larger swings than the typical stock.
meanings.beta: High beta — tends to amplify market moves by 50% or more.
meanings.mdd1y: Moderate 1-year drawdown — typical for most stocks.
meanings.sharpe: Modest risk-adjusted return — gains barely exceed volatility.
meanings.pe: Moderate P/E ratio — fairly valued relative to current earnings.
meanings.peVsSector: Trading at a significant premium to its sector peers.
meanings.revGrowth: Strong revenue growth, expanding the top line.
meanings.epsGrowth: Strong earnings growth, bottom line improving.
meanings.roe: Strong return on equity, generating solid returns for shareholders.
meanings.de: High leverage — significant debt load relative to equity.
meanings.liquidity: Highly liquid — ample trading volume and depth.
